Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon's DP is increased/reduced by another effect, does this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect target my opponent’s Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon’s DP after it's increased/reduced?

Effect: ＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost)
[On Play][When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon’s DP.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it gets +1000 DP.
